# OpenTelemetry License Provenance & Compliance Evidence

Project: OpenTelemetry
Component Family: OpenTelemetry Python API, SDK, Contrib Instrumentation, OTLP Exporter, and Collector
Verified License Identifier: Apache-2.0 (Apache License, Version 2.0)
Verification Date: 2026-09-29
Compliance Disposition: ACCEPTABLE (Permissive open source; approved for Phase-1 Task-1K adoption)

## Verified Upstream Sources

1. OpenTelemetry Python API & SDK
   - Package Names: opentelemetry-api, opentelemetry-sdk
   - Official Upstream Repository: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python
   - Official LICENSE Location: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python/blob/main/LICENSE
   - License: Apache-2.0
   - Phase-1 Role: Core in-process telemetry API, TracerProvider, MeterProvider, and BatchSpanProcessor

2. OpenTelemetry Python Contrib Instrumentation
   - Package Names: opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi, opentelemetry-instrumentation-sqlalchemy
   - Official Upstream Repository: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-contrib
   - Official LICENSE Location: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-contrib/blob/main/LICENSE
   - License: Apache-2.0
   - Phase-1 Role: Inbound HTTP route instrumentation (FastAPI); database query instrumentation (SQLAlchemy, deferred pending query privacy validation)

3. OpenTelemetry OTLP HTTP Exporter
   - Package Name: opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http
   - Official Upstream Repository: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python
   - Official LICENSE Location: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python/blob/main/LICENSE
   - License: Apache-2.0
   - Phase-1 Role: In-process push exporter transmitting spans and metrics over HTTP/protobuf to the local OpenTelemetry Collector

4. OpenTelemetry Collector & Collector Contrib
   - Distribution / Container Image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib
   - Official Upstream Repository: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib
   - Official LICENSE Location: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/blob/main/LICENSE
   - License: Apache-2.0
   - Phase-1 Role: Decoupled container service receiving OTLP/HTTP telemetry, providing local trace sink, and exposing Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint

## Attribution & Usage Policy
- Import and consume unmodified binary distributions/wheels as versioned package dependencies.
- Retain official Apache-2.0 license headers and NOTICE files in distribution manifests.
- Zero source code copying into the IR proprietary application core.
